result_text:
The warehouse stock list no longer shows products with nothing left. The full test suite passes offline (`mvn -q -o test`, no output), and I did not commit.

- **Fix:** `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/StockStore.java`, `listInWarehouse`. The query now filters `s.quantity > 0`, the same condition the other stock overviews use. I also updated its doc comment to say so.
- **Test:** `src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/StockOverviewTest.java`, new `warehouseStockLeavesOutProductsWithNothingLeft`. It takes all nuts out, sets screws to 0, and checks that WH-1's stock list is just "Bolt 10" while the nut quantity still answers 0. That test and the other four in the class pass.
